$comment: Accepted dependency advisories. Read by scripts/security/audit-gate.mjs, which fails on any critical/high advisory that is NOT listed here, and on any entry whose review_by date has passed. An entry is only legitimate when the fix is a major bump we have not scheduled, or no fix is published. Reachability claims must stay falsifiable: point at the code, or say the package is not shipped.

accepted.summary: MSAL Node authorization code flow may disclose parameters to an attacker-controlled endpoint (CWE-346)
accepted.reason: Fix requires @azure/msal-node 7.x while @azure/identity stays on ^5.1.0. Not reachable: no import of @azure/identity or @azure/msal-node anywhere in packages/**/*.ts (grep returns nothing). Pulled in transitively by astro/unstorage/nitro/tedious.

accepted.summary: Incomplete fix for CVE-2026-33943: unsanitized import alias leads to host code execution (CWE-94)
accepted.reason: Fix requires happy-dom 21.x (major) while app/ui/contracts test harnesses are on 20.11.1. Test-only dependency, present in no shipped artefact. Scheduled with the test-harness upgrade.

accepted.summary: SSRF via iframe and link stylesheet when parsing untrusted HTML (CWE-918)
accepted.reason: Same major bump as GHSA-834v-8h66-3h79. Test-only dependency; no untrusted HTML is parsed in a shipped process.

accepted.summary: Quadratic-complexity DoS via many array-of-tables headers in toml.parse() (CWE-407)
accepted.reason: Fix requires toml 5.x (major) against effect 4.0.0-beta.43. Not reachable: no Unifia code imports the toml module of effect and toml.parse is never called from packages/**.

accepted.summary: Quadratic-complexity DoS via long dotted keys or table paths in toml.parse() (CWE-407)
accepted.reason: Same major bump and same non-reachability argument as GHSA-4qx8-w7c3-pj3p.

accepted.summary: Uncontrolled resource consumption (CPU DoS) via unbounded-length integer literals in toml.parse() (CWE-400, CWE-770)
accepted.reason: Same major bump and same non-reachability argument as GHSA-4qx8-w7c3-pj3p.

accepted.summary: launch-editor command injection via a crafted request on Windows (CWE-77)
accepted.reason: The vulnerable range (<=5.4.8) only matches the vite 4.5.14 copy that @jsx-email/cli pins; the workspace copy is 7.3.7 and is not affected. Fixing the 4.5.14 copy needs a major the mail tooling cannot take. Dev-server / build tooling, never shipped.

accepted.summary: launch-editor fs.existsSync() existence check can be bypassed on Windows (CWE-77)
accepted.reason: The vulnerable range (<=6.4.3) only matches the vite 4.5.14 copy from @jsx-email/cli; the workspace copy is 7.3.7. Same blocking major as GHSA-c27g-q93r-2cwf.

accepted.summary: Zod can exhaust memory while validating oversized constrained collections (CWE-770)
accepted.reason: Tried and reverted: zod 4.6.6 makes packages/contracts fail `tsc --noEmit` with TS4023 on four exported schemas (ArtifactRefSchema, ArtifactRecordSchema, WorkflowVersionSchema, WorkflowIRSchema) because 4.6.6's inference no longer lets the branded __digestBrand type be named. Verified by A/B: contracts typecheck exits 0 at 4.1.8 and 2 at 4.6.6. Bumping needs a contracts refactor first, so the workspace stays on 4.1.8. The advisory also matches the zod 3.22.3 / 3.24.2 / 3.25.76 copies required by jimp, gitlab-ai-provider, opencontrol, miniflare, zod-to-json-schema and @hono/zod-validator, where 4.x is a breaking major.

accepted.summary: Denial of service via trailing bytes after a compressed request body (CWE-400)
accepted.reason: Two incompatible majors are live at once: express 4.22.2 (top-level and @slack/bolt) needs body-parser 1.x, while express 5 under @modelcontextprotocol/sdk needs 2.x. A flat override can only force one of them and would break the other chain. Reproduced with the CI-pinned bun 1.3.11: pinning via bun update moves the top-level copy but leaves 1.20.6 under @slack/bolt and 2.3.0 under the MCP SDK. Reachability is partial: only the shipped Slack Bolt HTTP server parses bodies, and the DoS needs an attacker-controlled compressed body on that route. Remedy path: per-parent overrides once the express majors converge, tracked separately.
